content: FRIDAY uses providers/failover.py as the model gateway. Set FRIDAY_LLM=off to bypass inference. Test with pytest --llm-mode=on/off/slow/garbage while provider contract tests retain their own mocks. Requested scheduling uses deterministic checks. Model-derived date proposals and translated commands require owner confirmation. Keep fixed within-day clocks for budget tests and set Tcl/Tk library paths for serial Windows UI verification.

FRIDAY T2 adds a deterministic presentation-only emotion and character snapshot. Authored templates or lines explicitly approved in the existing ReviewStore may be spoken. Live model replies remain review text. Verified on/off with 57 current acceptance checks and 3,835 broader regression cases per profile including the Tk reruns.

FRIDAY T3 uses the effective timetable and existing P3 estimates in a local rhythm, one durable speech budget and cause ledger alongside existing review budgets, existing verified outcomes for a confidence ceiling on autonomy, and versioned teacher proposals scoped to an actual offer. Rule-based command normalization and local deadline batch routing keep working with the model off. Acceptance verified 100 command examples plus simulated weeks in both model modes and scoped owner-confirmation regressions.
